name: 16509 · Erie, PA
findings: ZIP 16509 (Erie) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16509 (Erie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 16509 (Erie) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
